title: Hero Worship Versus Franchise Loyalty: Who Do Punjab Kings Fans Really Follow?
dek: Do Punjab Kings fans follow the badge or the stars? The data cannot read fans' minds, but it shows how much the franchise's story has depended on a few names.
excerpt: KL Rahul has scored a large share of Punjab Kings' runs. The more a franchise's history rests on a few players, the more its fans' loyalty is tied up with them.
author: CricField Editorial Desk

sections.heading: Stars and Badges
body: Every franchise has fans who would follow a favourite player anywhere and fans who would support the badge whoever wore it. The balance matters when stars leave.
The CricField warehouse holds no survey, sentiment or social-media data, so it cannot measure what fans feel. It can measure what they have watched.

sections.heading: How Much the Story Rests on a Few Names
body: {{ev:hw-r1}} has scored {{ev:hw-r1s}} of Punjab Kings' runs, and the top three run-scorers account for {{ev:hw-top3}}. The chart lists the leading run-scorers and their share.
With the ball, {{ev:hw-w1}} has taken {{ev:hw-w1s}} of the franchise's bowler-credited wickets.

sections.heading: When the Hero Leaves
body: A franchise whose history is concentrated in a few names faces a test when those players retire or move. Fan loyalty is then tested against the badge alone.

sections.heading: Building Loyalty That Outlasts Stars
body: Franchises protect against star dependence by building identity around the club: a home ground, a style of play and long-term community links.
Measuring whether that works would need fan data from before and after a star's departure.

sections.heading: CricField Verdict: Know the Concentration
body: Punjab Kings' on-field story has leaned on its leading players to the degree shown above.
That concentration is a measure of how much fan attachment may be riding on a few names.

methodology: CricField holds ball-by-ball cricket data and no fan survey, sentiment or social-media data. This article measures the cricket fans have experienced; statements about fans themselves are labelled hypotheses. Generated by scripts/editorial/engine. Bowler-credited wickets exclude run outs, retirements and obstructing the field.
